_status_values: draft (copied to prereg/PRIMARY.json for prereg-v2) -> frozen (prereg-v3, after the held-out scoring mode of the analysis code is committed and reviewed). unseal.py refuses unless status is frozen AND the prereg-v3 tag holds this exact file.
_about: DRAFT 2026-10-12 (decision row: see reports/prereg_arb_plan.md). Replaces the skeleton's H4 primary endpoint, which can no longer be tested: the M' pilot was NO-GO under a rule declared before its result (EV-0447, EV-0502), so no trained M/PF arm exists at HO-tr and none enters batch A. The only confirmatory question left is whether the FROZEN inference-time selftri rule (IDEA-004, IDEAEV-0065: chosen in-sample on the dev half, EV-0402; frozen before any KITTI-12 number, EV-0403; tested against +FF on KITTI-12, EV-0406) outperforms the authors' released checkpoint and the authors' +FF on the sealed KITTI-15 held-out half. Every arm is inference-only on the released kitti.pth: no training, no seed variance in S; +FF uses the three FF seeds GATE-0 declared. No threshold, band, teacher or code path may change after prereg-v3.

primary_endpoint.estimand: G = Fl-all(rel) - Fl-all(arb) in percentage points on the KITTI-15 held-out half (100 images of splits/k15_split_v1.json heldout_ids); positive = the rule lowers the outlier rate
primary_endpoint.fl_rule: KITTI-15 outlier rule: EPE > 3 px and > 5 % of |F_gt| (evaluate.py:860), over V_occ (all GT-valid pixels)

arms.rel: S = U2Flow kitti.pth 10->11 prediction at GT resolution (resize_flow, the evaluator path): the GATE-0 predictions EXP-002-audit-s1 (pins.data). On dev these are bit-identical to the dump's native_10to11 that the rule was tuned with (dump_eval.py compare, max |diff| 0.0 px over 100 ids); on held-out the dump holds no native flow, and the GT-free check s_producer_check.py shows the same fp16-grid residual on both halves (EV-0577 fix, see L53)
arms.arb: R = T where T is finite and alpha_S > 2.75 and |T - S| <= 100 px, else S. T = selftri/native/w03-11, the three-frame rigid refit of kitti.pth's own 10->09 and 10->11 grid flows (tools/p1/self_triangulate.py, cache U2FLOW_data/derived/evalselftri/v2), rendered at GT resolution for held-out ids by tools/p1/render_heldout.py, which calls the SAME render function render_frig.py uses for dev and KITTI-12 (render_frig.py itself is unchanged and keeps refusing held-out ids; dev parity 96/96 bit-identical, commit 7e9535c); alpha_S = kitti.pth alpha_10to11 from U2FLOW_data/runs/p1-dump-eval-u2flow-r1 (bilinear, align_corners=True, no scaling)
arms.ff: +FF of the authors (train_fusion_kitti.py sha256 d8659b763453a1fdf7adb963a4d15c9a947992cd73eb8104adb765738764e37f: thr 35, iters 2000, lr 0.01), FF seeds 1, 2, 3 exactly as GATE-0 G0.3 declared: EXP-003-ff-s1/s2/s3, pred_sha dd0e5d721151018da39692944bcc6716bd0d2d09b1d28f42105306d87b8cf2e0, cc7a7c2d2c11222d8206e0db708d900c34e36a4339d35b02c23b7ffeadc8eb3c, 6f958388c530f1a8d3dedd88d69c22ccd16f0a512660d928d98803d7084b8890
arms.ffarb: FF+R = T where T is finite and alpha_S > 2.75 and |T - FF_s| <= 100 px, else FF_s (selftri_vs_ff.py text_ff), for each FF seed s

frozen_rule.d_gt_px: none (the rule has no lower band edge)
frozen_rule.frozen_by: IDEAEV-0065 (IDEA-004), before any KITTI-12 number; reports/p1_region/arbitration_frozen_k12.json (code 217e584); IDEA-005 code 958c381

primary_endpoint.missing_teacher: Held-out windows 000091 and 000094 have no selftri item: recoverPose found 0 points in front (U2FLOW_data/runs/p1-selftri-r1/out/cache/diag/selftri/failures.csv). They keep R = S (and FF+R = FF_s) and stay in the denominator; the cache's item list is pinned (pins.data_manifest), so no later run may fill them. The rule was tuned on dev with 96/100 windows (000043, 000046, 000113, 000114 missing for the same reason, same handling).

ci.method: paired image bootstrap (tools/eval/stats.py paired_image_bootstrap via arbitration_cv.frozen_stats), percentile
ci.levels: primary 0.95; S1 and S2 0.975 each (Bonferroni over the two secondaries, see multiplicity); the scorer takes the level per comparison

outcomes._decision_order: invalid is checked first; then ci_low_gt_0 (lo > 0), ci_high_lt_0 (hi < 0), otherwise ci_spans_0 (lo <= 0 <= hi, a CI end exactly at 0 included). Exactly one sentence is used, verbatim, with G, lo, hi filled from the scorer.
outcomes.invalid: The held-out ARB test is invalid and no result is stated: <reason>. One of: fewer than 100 held-out images scored; a pinned code or data sha differs; the rel-level integrity check failed; a row other than batch A's was computed before unseal B.
outcomes.ci_low_gt_0: On the sealed KITTI-15 held-out half (100 images, held out from the rule's tuning but not from the checkpoint's unsupervised training, L5), the frozen selftri rule lowers the released U2Flow kitti.pth's Fl-all (px-pooled) by G pp [lo, hi]: it outperforms the released checkpoint, at the cost of a three-frame rigid refit per image.
outcomes.ci_high_lt_0: On the sealed KITTI-15 held-out half (100 images, held out from the rule's tuning but not from the checkpoint's unsupervised training, L5), the frozen selftri rule raises the released U2Flow kitti.pth's Fl-all (px-pooled) by |G| pp [lo, hi]: it is worse than the released checkpoint.
outcomes.ci_spans_0: On the sealed KITTI-15 held-out half (100 images, held out from the rule's tuning but not from the checkpoint's unsupervised training, L5), the frozen selftri rule changes the released U2Flow kitti.pth's Fl-all (px-pooled) by G pp [lo, hi]: no difference larger than these bounds is shown.

primary_endpoint._protocol_why: kitti.pth's unsupervised training saw neighbouring frames of every KITTI-15 training scene, held-out included (limitations L5). The held-out half is held out from the RULE's tuning (dev, EV-0402) and from every agent's view of its GT, never from the checkpoint's training (critic EV-0572).

pins._rule: Code pins live in analysis_code.code_sha256 (every file the held-out scorer's HO_PINNED lists) and frozen_rule.code_sha256; input pins in inputs_sha256. The scorer (selftri_vs_ff.py --heldout-batch) re-hashes all of them and refuses (exit 7) on any difference before reading a held-out pixel. pins.data_manifest pins the remaining data files; pins.registration is null until the ARB experiments are registered, and unseal.py refuses while any null is left in primary_endpoint.

data_manifest.path: prereg/arb_data_manifest.json (copied from prereg/drafts/ at the prereg-v2 commit; byte-identical, so this sha holds)
data_manifest._what: per-file sha256 of the 98 held-out selftri items and the cache settings, the dump's MANIFEST.vm.json sha (every file verified on the Mac 2026-10-12), PREDS.json and metrics.json shas and full pred_sha of EXP-002-audit-s1 and EXP-003-ff-s1/s2/s3, and the held-out T render's sha; filled when the render sha is in and the file is final

registration._what: the EXP ids registered after prereg-v2 with --prereg-tag prereg-v2, --split-scope heldout, --eval-only, --protocol FULL, family ARB (reports/prereg_arb_plan.md step 4); run ids EXP-NNN-<arm>-s<seed>, rel and arb seed 1, ff and ffarb seeds 1-3 = the FF seeds

validity_checks.rel_level: After unseal A and before any contrast is computed, the scorer derives the held-out Fl-all (px-pooled) of rel from the GATE-0 aggregate RES-0032 (all 200) and the dev row RES-0001 with their pixel counts, and compares it with the rel level it scores from held-out GT: they must agree to 1e-6 pp and the pixel count must equal n_all - n_dev exactly, else the run is invalid and stops (a GT-integrity check, critic EV-0575). This derivation is computed only after unseal, never before.
validity_checks.n_images: exactly the 100 heldout_ids of splits/k15_split_v1.json are scored for every arm and FF seed
validity_checks.batch_scope: while only batch A is unsealed, the scorer computes only the rows declared in unseal_batches.A (Fl, region all, px-pooled, step final, the four arms, plus the contrasts G, H_s, K_s and their CIs) and refuses any other region, metric or aggregation until unseal.jsonl records batch B (critic EV-0573)

primary_endpoint.level_rows_note: The rel and ff level rows of batch A are implied by the GATE-0 aggregates (L48); they are recorded for completeness and for the rel_level check. The new information is in arb, ffarb and the contrasts.

secondaries.what: the rule versus the authors' +FF: H_s = Fl-all(ff_s) - Fl-all(arb), s = 1, 2, 3
secondaries.decision: intersection-union over the three FF seeds

outcomes.all_ci_low_gt_0: The rule alone outperforms the authors' +FF on the held-out half for every FF seed (H_1, H_2, H_3 with 97.5 % CIs).
outcomes.all_ci_high_lt_0: The rule alone is worse than the authors' +FF on the held-out half for every FF seed.
outcomes.otherwise: No consistent difference between the rule and +FF across the three FF seeds; the three intervals are reported.
outcomes._decision_order: invalid (as for the primary) first; then all three CIs with lo > 0; then all three with hi < 0; otherwise the third sentence (a CI end at 0 counts as spanning 0)

secondaries.what: +FF followed by the rule versus +FF: K_s = Fl-all(ff_s) - Fl-all(ffarb_s), s = 1, 2, 3
secondaries.decision: intersection-union over the three FF seeds

outcomes.all_ci_low_gt_0: The rule improves on top of the authors' +FF on the held-out half for every FF seed.
outcomes.all_ci_high_lt_0: The rule makes +FF worse on the held-out half for every FF seed.
outcomes.otherwise: No consistent effect of the rule on top of +FF across the three FF seeds; the three intervals are reported.
outcomes._decision_order: invalid (as for the primary) first; then all three CIs with lo > 0; then all three with hi < 0; otherwise the third sentence (a CI end at 0 counts as spanning 0)

multiplicity.secondaries: Bonferroni over S1 and S2 (each 97.5 % two-sided CIs), the primary alone at 95 %. This departs from statistics.md (Holm within the S family): decisions here are read from confidence intervals, not p-values, and Bonferroni intervals are the simultaneous-coverage form that is conservative against Holm; declared before any held-out number (critic EV-0578). The intersection-union over the three FF seeds inside S1 and S2 needs no further correction.

not_tested: H4 (M vs PF at HO-tr) and the former S1-S3: no trained arm exists (EV-0502 NO-GO; reports/REPORT_draft.md section 11). They are reported as not tested, never as negative.
drive_cluster_rule: none: the robustness bootstrap is not run (image is the unit; L3 names the 29 unmapped sequences)

B.what: exploratory, unadjusted; NOT unsealed or scored in this phase: the held-out scorer builds batch A rows only (HO_BUILT_ROWS), so R1, R3, occ Fl, EPE, switch shares and per-image signs stay sealed

analysis_code.scorer: tools/p1/selftri_vs_ff.py held-out mode (commit 7e9535c and its reviewed successor; GT read only through tools/prereg/seal.py heldout_members after unseal; rows stamped by seal.stamp_rows; batch-scoped per validity_checks.batch_scope; pins re-hashed per pins._rule)
analysis_code.invocation: .venv/bin/python tools/p1/selftri_vs_ff.py --heldout-batch A --run rel=<EXP>-rel-s1 --run arb=<EXP>-arb-s1 --run ff-s1=<EXP>-ff-s1 --run ff-s2=... --run ff-s3=... --run ffarb-s1=<EXP>-ffarb-s1 --run ffarb-s2=... --run ffarb-s3=... (inputs default to the pinned paths; ids from pins.registration)
analysis_code._code_pins_why: Key names are the scorer's own: analysis_code.code_sha256 (HO_PINNED files), primary_endpoint.frozen_rule.code_sha256, inputs_sha256. A pin mismatch, including a TODO-PIN left in place, makes selftri_vs_ff.py --heldout-batch exit 7 before any held-out pixel is read.

Before prereg-v3: record the held-out S-producer agreement check (done 2026-10-12, see L53) and re-run the u2f-critic on this file.

inputs_sha256._what: pred_sha (eval_kitti.pred_sha over PREDS.json shards) of S, T and each +FF seed; sha256 of the alpha/flow dump's cache manifest.json

notes_dev_reference: S2 seed 1 on dev (in-sample) is 0.335 pp with the GATE-0 FF arm EXP-003-ff-s1, not EV-0406's 0.320 pp, which used the p1-ff-eval-r3 FF cache (L51); recorded by the code fork's reproduction check, commit 7e9535c.
